Anya (CS): Quick heads-up — NovaHealth just notified us that three new internal teams are going live this week: personalization, clinician-assistant, billing-sync. They expect a ~3x increase in chat tokens and a 6x bump in embedding requests over the next 30 days. Asking for guidance on capacity + any immediate enablement items.

Priya (AE): Nice — do we know if this is steady-state or a short pilot?

Anya (CS): Ben said it's rolling org-level: personalization and clinician-assistant are productized; billing-sync is internal but high QPS. They want low-latency for clinician flows and strict data isolation for billing (PII). Renewal in 5 months — they mentioned growth is why they'd consider dedicated.

Tom (SRE): @Anya can you paste the current qps/avg p95 from the last 7 days? also, do they plan concurrent sessions with long contexts? that changes memory footprint.

Ben (NovaHealth): Hey all, quick notes from our side: expect many short chat sessions (avg 80 tokens) for clinician-assistant but heavy embedding bulk jobs for nightly reconciliation (~2M vectors/day). Can't expose raw patient IDs; we'll need KMS+VPC. Looking at MLP and billing teams to onboard later this quarter.

Anya (CS): Sharing current metrics: last 7d avg QPS ~200, p95 latency 420ms (hosted), embeddings 40k/day. Projection from their infra lead: peak QPS ~700, embeddings ~2M/day as Ben said.

Tom (SRE): That spike suggests Dedicated or reserved capacity for embeddings/large batch windows. Also suggest enabling prefix caching for clinician-assistant and pinning a quantized model variant for billing to lower cost. I'll open infra ticket.

eng-ops-bot: Created ticket CS-1129: 'NovaHealth expansion — capacity evaluation + privacy config'. Assigned to Tom, tag: dedicated-eval, kms-integration.

Priya (AE): I'll schedule a 30-min enablement w/ product + infra to align SLOs/rollout. Can we prepare a short playbook: recommended model profiles, batching windows, and estimated monthly $ impact?

Ben (NovaHealth): Thanks — can we get a conservative cost estimate and a checklist for KMS/VPC? We'll share internal timelines once we confirm budgets.

Anya (CS): On it. Priya/Tom — let's aim for Friday 10am PT. I'll prepare usage projections and an enablement checklist. :thumbsup: 

Tom (SRE): Adding a short command snippet to test embeddings throughput locally:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
 -d '{"model":"embed-large-v2","input":"[...large-batch...]"}'
```

Anya (CS): Marking as high priority for onboarding ops. I'll update CS-1129 with notes after the meeting.
